orig.il: And it came to pass, while there was war
with me, and, behold, my hand
with thee, and that thou mayest reign
for he had sent him away

orig.gloss: and/ he has sent away/ him
orig.il: and he hath sent him away

orig.gloss: and/ [one who] has a skin disease

orig.il: that it was not of the king
ye not that there is a prince
